title: Inside L.A.’s ‘Lorne’ Premiere: ‘Saturday Night Live’ Boss Opens Up on Doc About His Life in Rare Interview With Donna Langley
summary: The ‘SNL’ honcho covered taking his hit sketch show to the U.K. and where he gets his wisdom from in a 35-minute Q&A with the NBCUniversal chairperson: "Remember almost all the nice things that were said about me were said by people who’ve left the show."
